craft_evidence.owned: no: no owned factory, mill or workshop named; about page says John Elliott is on the ground floor of production daily (a claim, no place named)
craft_evidence.makers: no: no maker named on any PDP; Square Toe Boot says made in a small family-owned factory in the Marche region of Italy (unnamed, a claim)
craft_evidence.mills: partly: Cone Mills named on 13 of 232 clothing products (3x1 Cone Mills denim); Japanese denim described by origin (Kojima on 8) with no mill named; no other mill named
craft_evidence.madein: 191 of 232 clothing products (82%) state country in the description: Peru 70, China 51, Japan 26, Turkey 19, Portugal 16, Mexico 4, Los Angeles 3, Italy 2
craft_evidence.heritage: dated, loosely placed: founded 2012 by John Elliott, a San Francisco native and Los Angeles-based designer (about page); no founding address
craft_evidence.process: partly: per-product notes on processes (hand-burnished Dive wash on boots, enzyme washing, hand distressing and paint, GSM weights, Air Spun recycled-yarn knit); no page on how or where the range is made
craft_evidence.reasoning: John Elliott states the country of make on 82% of clothing products across eight countries, but owns no facility and names no maker; the Italian boot factory is described, not named. One mill is named (Cone Mills, on 13 denim products) and the Japanese denim is given by region only. Process is described garment by garment rather than documented as a making system. A 3 is arguable if the Cone Mills naming is weighed.
